description: In auth.rs, dmarc_reject is set when policy=reject AND DKIM fails AND SPF fails. There is no ARC (Authenticated Received Chain, RFC 8617) bypass: messages forwarded through mailing lists that break DKIM alignment will be rejected even when the ARC chain proves the original message was DMARC-compliant. The mail-auth library supports ARC validation and the ARC chain is verified in verify_inbound, but the result is not consulted before setting dmarc_reject. This is a known v1 simplification but it means stoa will reject legitimate mailing-list traffic from DMARC-strict senders like gmail.com and yahoo.com.
title: smtp: DMARC reject skips ARC bypass for mailing lists
